relationship: Moving the mantissa–exponent divider connects a fixed bit budget to precision, range and representation trade-offs.

learnerLoop.action: Move the divider and inspect the selected floating-point word.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Bits are allocated differently between mantissa and exponent.
learnerLoop.evidence: The ruler, word display, normaliser and precision/range explanations update.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Choose an allocation that fits the stated measurement need.

invariants: The total word length remains fixed while allocation changes.
The displayed word, ruler, normalisation and storage feedback remain consistent with the selected mantissa–exponent allocation.
Precision and range comparisons remain tied to the same represented value and bit budget.
safeAdaptations: Change the measurement context, wording or guided prompts while retaining the fixed-budget precision/range trade-off.
nonGoals: Modelling every floating-point standard or hardware implementation.

task.description: Measurement context and quantitative storage requirement.
task.visibility: Visible in the corresponding lesson, simulation or result state.

controls.description: Choose context; allocate the eight bits; shift the stored mantissa with compensating exponent or reset the form.
controls.visibility: Visible in the corresponding lesson, simulation or result state.

model.description: Context instrument, global/local representable values and selected binary storage word.
model.visibility: Visible in the corresponding lesson, simulation or result state.

evidence.description: Error, distinction/tolerance checks, normalisation and information-loss feedback. Precision/range cards distinguish the trade-off; a met goal has green contrast and a check.
evidence.visibility: Visible in the corresponding lesson, simulation or result state.

allocation.domain: Eight total bits; 2–6 mantissa bits and the remaining 6–2 exponent bits.

representation.description: Signed fixed-point mantissa times a power of two.
representation.domain: Two’s-complement mantissa and exponent; nearest representable values, underflow and overflow.
representation.source: Selected sample and current allocation; optional compensated shifts.

modes.contexts: Filament, Current, Forecast and Impact are freely selectable measurement challenges.
modes.support: No artificial Working or exam selector. Normaliser is available for dataset contexts.

dependencies: The total eight-bit budget is fixed. Changing its split recomputes representation, errors, precision and range.
Filament checks five distinct readings within 0.025 mm; Current uses relative error within 20%; Forecast accumulates rounded iterations.
Impact requires examining all five allocations to expose the precision/range conflict. Manual shifts compensate the exponent and explicitly report lost information or exponent limits.
The allocation divider changes the mantissa/exponent bit split; the separate mantissa shift compensates the exponent until precision loss or limits change the stored value.
implementation.completion: Context-specific measurement checks; Impact exposes why no available allocation satisfies the combined requirement.
limitations: An eight-bit teaching model, not IEEE 754 hardware. Context datasets are scaled to expose the trade-off.
